497:t_008:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Let's hope he never stands against us again...」

497:t_008:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So he...believed in the god of space, too.」

497:t_008:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Only humans possess a god...the power to change the future... It is the god called possibility.」

497:t_008:8.en:
$$シャア$$
(I'm sorry, $$ギュネイ$$... My inadequacy made you suffer...)

497:t_008:9.en:
$$シャア$$
(I've made up my mind, too. In this battle...)

497:t_008:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Watch out! Their main force is coming!」

497:t_009:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That purple machine...! It's Captain $$アンジェロ$$!」

497:t_009:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Damn $$ギュネイ$$. I left him the vanguard, but he seems to have achieved very little.」

497:t_009:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「No matter. I won't be outmatched by $c with its forces dispersed.」

497:t_009:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$カミーユ$$... Concentrate your attacks on that commander's machine.」

497:t_009:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Here I come, $c...! I'll crush you here and dispose of all the fools who oppose the Colonel!」

497:t_010:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The $$ローゼン・ズール$$ the Colonel gave me is finally adapting to me...! Now I can do this!」

497:t_010:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That man...! Has he sworn personal loyalty to $$フル・フロンタル$$...!?」

497:t_010:2.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ was fighting for personal reasons too, but this guy is even worse!」

497:t_010:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I resent being lumped in with such an incompetent!」

497:t_012:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$! What is the meaning of this!?」

497:t_012:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You've got a lot of nerve talking big when you can't even dodge an incompetent's $$ファンネル$$s.」

497:t_012:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That was a warning. Next time I'll hit you directly, $$アンジェロ$$.」

497:t_012:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You bastard! Are you going to defect from $$ネオ・ジオン$$!?」

497:t_012:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm not fighting $$ジオン$$! I'm fighting $$フル・フロンタル$$, who wags his tail for $$サイデリアル$$, and the people who follow him!」

497:t_012:8.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm not doing this because you or $$カミーユ$$ told me to.」

497:t_012:9.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I always knew this day would come eventually. It just happened to be today.」

497:t_012:10.en:
$$シン$$
「What are you talking about!? You...」

497:t_012:14.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$! You've disgraced the name of $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

497:t_012:15.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$フロンタル$$'s the one who's done that, by forgetting his pride as a human!」

497:t_012:16.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Here I come, $$アンジェロ$$! I'll change $$ネオ・ジオン$$ in my own way!」

497:t_013:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tch! Are you saying I can't master the $$ローゼン・ズール$$!?」

497:t_013:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「We're retreating! All units, follow me!」

497:t_016:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$! Have you come to finish me off!?」

497:t_016:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$... I surrender to you.」

497:t_016:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you serious!? What the hell are you doing that for!?」

497:t_016:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Very well. The Colonel will be pleased if I've captured you.」

497:t_016:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「I am surrendering. I would like you to remember that.」

497:t_016:10.en:
$$シャア$$
($$アムロ$$... I'm counting on you to handle the rest.)

497:t_017:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「H-hey! Is he going back to being $$ジオン$$'s $$赤い彗星$$!?」

497:t_017:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$...intends to make contact with $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

497:t_017:4.en:
$n
「What on earth is he doing that for?」

497:t_017:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Probably to learn what he himself could become...」

497:t_017:7.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You sound pathetic, $$カミーユ$$. Can't you do anything without the Colonel?」

497:t_017:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No... You're right, $$ギュネイ$$.」

497:t_017:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(You will come back, I'm sure... So we'll continue our own fight.)

497:t_018:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「H-hey! Is he going back to being $$ジオン$$'s $$赤い彗星$$!?」

497:t_018:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$...intends to make contact with $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

497:t_018:4.en:
$n
「What on earth is he doing that for?」

497:t_018:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Probably to learn what he himself could become...」

497:t_018:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(You will come back, I'm sure... So we'll continue our own fight.)

497:t_019:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're persistent, $$カミーユ$$! You and I are enemies!」

497:t_019:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But there's no reason for us to fight! Even you can't think this will benefit humanity!」
